name: co2-ppm
title: CO₂ concentration at Mauna Loa (the Keeling Curve)
description: Atmospheric carbon dioxide concentration measured at Mauna Loa Observatory, Hawaii — the longest continuous record of atmospheric CO₂, begun by C. David Keeling in March 1958 and maintained by NOAA and Scripps. Monthly means from 1958 and annual means from 1959, in parts per million (ppm) of dry air.

resources.name: co2-monthly-mlo
resources.title: Monthly mean CO₂ at Mauna Loa

fields.name: date
fields.description: First day of the month the mean refers to (YYYY-MM-01). NOAA reports monthly values corrected to the centre of the month using the average seasonal cycle.

fields.name: decimal_date
fields.description: Mid-month date as a decimal year, as supplied by NOAA.

fields.name: co2_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO₂ mole fraction in parts per million (ppm) of dry air. Missing months are filled by NOAA with an interpolated value (flagged by an empty std_dev / uncertainty).

fields.name: co2_ppm_deseasonalized
fields.description: The monthly mean with the average seasonal cycle removed (NOAA's 'deseasonalized' column; previously labelled 'trend').

fields.name: num_days
fields.description: Number of daily means used to compute the monthly mean. Empty where NOAA has no information (all data before May 1974, sourced from Scripps, and interpolated months). NOAA's -1 sentinel is normalised to an empty cell.

fields.name: std_dev
fields.description: Standard deviation of the daily means within the month (ppm). Empty where unknown; NOAA's -9.99 sentinel is normalised to an empty cell.

fields.name: uncertainty
fields.description: Estimated uncertainty of the monthly mean (ppm). Empty where unknown; NOAA's -0.99 sentinel is normalised to an empty cell.

resources.name: co2-annual-mlo
resources.title: Annual mean CO₂ at Mauna Loa

fields.name: co2_ppm_mean
fields.description: Annual mean CO₂ mole fraction in parts per million (ppm) of dry air, from the Mauna Loa record.

fields.name: uncertainty
fields.description: Estimated uncertainty in the annual mean (ppm), taken as the standard deviation of annual means determined independently by NOAA/ESRL and Scripps.
